city-01-1.rationale: Pages 4–5 require sprinklering, smoke detection, CO alarm and emergency lighting. The by-law-table reference adds little but the physical work and building-review context are clear.

city-01-3.rationale: Page 4 names the fire-safety systems required for the existing building. Building review preserves the later context; this is a concise statement of concrete work.
